instructions:
LRD-preconditioned MCLMC on ill_cond_50 (kappa=1000 rotated Gaussian).
Pipeline: (1) oracle rank-40 COV decomposition via decompose_covariance_low_rank; (2) LRD IMM stored as .imm.npz sidecar; (3) mclmc_find_L_and_step_size with make_lrd_kernel binding the LowRankInverseMassMatrix.
k=40 (oracle rank; NUTS-pilot extraction was not needed because the exact covariance is available via ill_cond_50.COV).
IMM checkpoint at inverse_mass_matrix_path; load with np.load to skip re-extraction.
The emitted run-script uses mclmc_lrd_tuning (NUTS pilot path) for portability; the oracle-IMM path is for the catalog artifact only.
notes:
Two evidence tracks verified by @statistician (2026-06-09):
(1) ORACLE path (emit_ill_cond_50_lrd_recipe.py): seeds [98765, 11111, 22222, 33333] all PASS, ESS/grad 0.243-0.254, ratios 450x-479x over diagonal. Uses decompose_covariance_low_rank(COV, k=40) directly — exact preconditioning, no pilot overhead. warmup_grad_evals=8000.
(2) PORTABLE/pilot path (emitted run-script — mclmc_lrd_tuning NUTS-pilot): seeds [44444, 55555, 66666] all PASS, ESS/grad 0.196-0.225 (81-93% of oracle; see attempted_configurations). Pilot adds ~4000 extra warmup grads → warmup_grad_evals≈12000 for portable path. headline_metric=0.2492 reflects oracle upper bound; portable path floor is ~0.20.
